title: Amazingly Crisp German Paneer Skillet
description: A nutty and crisp German dish featuring paneer, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a nostalgic treat, kneaded to perfection with a blend of spices and herbs.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and melt 1 tablespoon of butter.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the paneer to the skillet, cutting it into small cubes if necessary, and cook until it is golden brown on all sides.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the paneer and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the Amazingly Crisp German Paneer Skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
